exposure: Mobile Fetal Heart Monitor (Melody International Ltd, iCTG) device
cohort: The study included pregnant women at 32 gestational age or above in intervention facilities (n=492) and control facilities (n=271) in Tanzania.
finding: Implementing the iCTG device for antepartum FHR monitoring effectively detected abnormal FHR and was associated with improved newborn outcomes, including reduced Apgar scores < 7 at 5 min and fewer perinatal deaths, despite not improving ANC visit completion or institutional births.
mod_finding: The iCTG intervention was associated with an increased risk of caesarean section.
